hypothesis: Q5 true-R16 showed that eliminating Python/ctypes submissions can outweigh a small GPU-leaf delta, so exact one-launch Q4 R16 deserved one operation-complete revisit despite the prior R12 leaf-only rejection.

operation_complete.stop_reason: The operation-complete row regresses 6.39%; a full-suite run cannot retain the candidate.

decision.named_blocker: The 200-launch R16 reduction cannot cover 43-70% per-shape GPU penalties and a 55.3% weighted Q4 R16 GPU increase.
decision.reopen_only_if: A new Q4 dataflow reduces the GPU penalty materially; do not rerun the same col4/shared-weight morphologies or tune prompt/content selectors.
decision.next: Keep exact R8+R8 Q4 parents and attribute C4's remaining 2.63% AR deficit outside rejected Q4 one-sweep morphologies.
